rawContent: #DahmerNetflix is very hard to watch especially knowing that the police still don’t listen to or value our voices. This brother put his heart & soul into this scene b/c it’s real. I salute @dyllonburnside . His work is advocacy in action! #Blacklivesmatter #LGBTQlivesmatter https://t.co/o2DeJai0yy

We know saying Black Lives Matter speaks directly to ending police brutality & saying white lives matter speaks to protecting white power structures that allow it. Don’t believe the hype, race matters. #ProfessorJBA #teacher #BlackLivesMatter #WhiteLivesMatter #Whiteliesmatter 🍎

Many responses about #DahmerNetflix are centered on ppl’s attraction to Evan Peters who portrays #Dahmer. This man targeted & murdered Black/brown #LGBTQ males. The victims should be the one’s remembered but fan’s support overshadows justice to sensationalize a murderer. #BLM✊🏾

Haiti 🇭🇹, the Diaspora and the state of Blackness in this 🌍 are crying out to us for deliverance from oppression. #LiftMeUp from assimilation to an awakening of intentional action towards freedom. #ProfessorJBA #fridaymorning #storyteller #teacher #FreedomisnotFree #BLM 🍎 https://t.co/FJRod4Of7d
